title: Distribution Network for IP 2014
bodyHtml:
IP 2014 (with DVD) is available for sale from IPC Secretariat and its distributors.

I. IPC Secretariat:
The IP 2014 (in 04 volumes) with DVD can be procured from the office of the Secretary-cum-Scientific Director, IP Commission at CIPL Campus, RajNagar, Sector 23, Ghaziabad - 201 002 (UP) through Demand Draft @ Rs. 25,000/- (Rupees Twenty five thousand only) issued in favour of "Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission" payable at Ghaziabad.
